query: What mixed-methods sequencing (sequential explanatory, triangulation matrix) will systematically use qualitative moral language to refine survey items?

response.query: What mixed-methods sequencing (sequential explanatory, triangulation matrix) will systematically use qualitative moral language to refine survey items?
response.answer: Mixed-methods sequencing using sequential explanatory and triangulation matrix refines survey items by integrating qualitative moral language through thematic analysis and similarity matrices. This approach systematically enhances survey precision.
